document: ET-8b §13b gen1pp_dec — ONE SHARED head (理, option (i))
head_form: shared: one head for every decision point
⚠️_form_vs_published_gen1: the published gen1 is THREE per-decision heads on 2,824 rows. This arm is one shared head. A difference between this arm and published gen1 is a FORM difference as much as anything else and must never be quoted as an origin effect. The §13b pair is gen1' vs gen1-matched, both fitted here, both one shared head, both 1,437 rows.
why_shared: R7's SQL states carry no `decision` field — that experiment was single-decision — so three per-decision heads cannot be fitted from them. 理 ruled both sides of the pair to this form rather than spend 3 h of GPU regenerating SQL loop states.

head.evaluation: 5-fold CV over the TRAINING tasks (descriptive; the deployed head is fitted on all of them)

how_to_read_the_controls: permuted must collapse to chance. If PCA-8 or the row subsample matches the full head, the signal needs neither dimensions nor examples and is a key being copied.
the_bar: problems solved on a paired run (理). Probe accuracy is a sanity check.
